statusDetail: Akamai returned HTTP 403 Access Denied to raw CDP Chrome and plain HTTP requests, including the entry page, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml. The requested site UI and representative routes were therefore unreachable.

page.notes: Only Akamai’s access-denied document was observable. It is not treated as the audited site experience.

artifacts.caption: Raw-CDP browser capture showing the Akamai Access Denied response.
Rendered DOM of the access-denied response, with title and body text.
HTTP headers and bodies showing 403/access denial for the entry page, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml.
